source_commit_verification.method: git cat-file --batch at the exact source commit; every live file SHA equals the relevant captured bytes. Commit blob must be byte-equal or differ solely by CRLF/LF normalization with no NUL. Android old audit-only capture replaced by final rerun desktop audit in the union.

hash_semantics: Artifact and input SHA256 values describe the physical bytes frozen/built/packaged in this workspace. Git normalizes text to LF; source-commit comparison explicitly proves equality apart from CRLF/LF for text, and requires exact equality for all other bytes. The sole Android-capture desktop audit correction is absent from APK compilation and was included in the complete final desktop rerun.
